limits: This capture covers Microsoft Edge 154 on Windows only; other engines are separate evidence.
Trusted repeat is protocol evidence from Chromium DevTools dispatch and trusted DOM events, not physical keyboard hold duration or operating-system repeat timing.
data-ritk-frame-generation counts fresh RITK render-and-upload completions; it does not measure compositor presentation or playback cadence.

No native process-launch, OS-permission, or WebGPU claim is made.
Viewport and element PNGs show browser output; exact RGBA hashes cover canvas backing pixels.
Input geometry covers the gallery's borderless, unpadded, untransformed canvases; custom CSS embeddings require separate local-box validation.
